bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'GAYBBS_BUNDLE_PROVENANCE\n'
printf 'RUNNING_SHA='; docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1
printf 'IMAGE_CREATED='; docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Created}}'
printf 'COMPOSE_SOURCE='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}'
printf 'BUNDLE_MATCHES_BEGIN\n'
running="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d ' ' -f1)"
find /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot -type d \( -name node_modules -o -name .pnpm-store -o -name .git \) -prune -o -type f -name gaybbs.mjs -print | while IFS= read -r f; do hash="$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d ' ' -f1)"; if test "$hash" = "$running"; then printf 'MATCH=%s\n' "$f"; fi; done
printf 'BUNDLE_MATCHES_END\n'
printf 'WORKTREE_HEADS_BEGIN\n'
git worktree list --porcelain | grep -E '^(worktree|HEAD|branch)' | head -n 90 || true
printf 'WORKTREE_HEADS_END\n'
